newsitem.title: UK: Russia Novorossiisk oil port reopens, Odessa shut.
newsitem.headline: Russia Novorossiisk oil port reopens, Odessa shut.

text.p: Russia's leading oil export terminal at Novorossiisk on the Black Sea reopened on Friday after a 30-hour closure due to bad weather, shipping sources said.
The port closed at 0100 (local time) on Thursday as gale force winds and high swell prevented crude and oil product tankers from berthing.
With winds moderating to force four or five, the port reopened at 0730 (local time) on Friday allowing a million-barrel crude tanker to dock at berth one, a source said.
A smaller crude tanker was due to berth later in the morning.
Eight crude and product carriers were waiting at anchor outside the port, the source added.
Russia's Black Sea port of Tuapse was also open but Ukraine's Odessa remained shut.
The Baltic port of Ventspils was operating normally, sources said.
